interest: AAUW backing for Japanese women's suffrage as a safeguard against militarism.
overview: AAUW letters of October 1945 to Truman and Byrnes praising MacArthur's directive giving Japanese women the vote, and State's reply.

people.name: Douglas MacArthur
people.role: General of the Army / Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers

people.name: Kathryn McHale
people.role: General Director, American Association of University Women

people.name: Francis H. Russell
people.role: Acting Director, Office of Public Affairs, Department of State

subfiles.about: Kathryn McHale expresses the AAUW's deep satisfaction with the U.S. directive instructing the Japanese government to grant women the right to vote.
subfiles.from: Kathryn McHale, General Director, American Association of University Women
subfiles.summary: Kathryn McHale of the AAUW praises Truman and MacArthur for the directive enfranchising Japanese women.
subfiles.title: Letter from Kathryn McHale (AAUW) to President Harry S. Truman commending the directive on women's suffrage in Japan

subfiles.about: Kathryn McHale writes to Secretary of State Byrnes conveying the AAUW's support for the U.S. directive ordering women's enfranchisement in Japan.
subfiles.from: Kathryn McHale, General Director, American Association of University Women
subfiles.summary: Kathryn McHale tells Byrnes the AAUW welcomes the directive enfranchising Japanese women as a check on aggression.
subfiles.title: Letter from Kathryn McHale (AAUW) to Secretary of State James F. Byrnes regarding women's suffrage in Japan
subfiles.to: James F. Byrnes, Secretary of State

subfiles.about: The Department of State acknowledges Kathryn McHale's correspondence and affirms its commitment to fostering a peaceful, democratic Japan.
subfiles.from: Francis H. Russell, Acting Director, Office of Public Affairs (for the Secretary of State)
subfiles.summary: Francis H. Russell thanks the AAUW for its views on Japanese women's suffrage.
subfiles.title: Letter from Francis H. Russell (Department of State) to Kathryn McHale acknowledging AAUW views on women's enfranchisement in Japan
subfiles.to: Kathryn McHale, General Director, American Association of University Women
